name: @aptoma/biome-rules
author: Martin Jonsson <martin@aptoma.com>
description: Biome JS lint plugins that keep TypeScript types honest

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && node --test 'test/**/*.test.mts'
scripts.release: npm test && release-it --ci -i patch && npm publish
scripts.release:minor: npm test && release-it --ci -i minor && npm publish
scripts.release:major: npm test && release-it --ci -i major && npm publish
